note:
stock.location was the only contributor, and its finding is a false positive against the rule's own rationale.

Measured in a detached worktree at HEAD carrying only this change, at CI scope (--addons-path odoo/addons,addons, -i test_lint alone).

The rule exists because raising in unlink also blocks uninstalling the module (E8506). stock.location.unlink already excludes that path -- the raise is guarded on MODULE_UNINSTALL_FLAG -- so the harm the rule targets cannot occur here.

@api.ondelete cannot express the check either. unlink() expands self to the whole child_of subtree and re-dispatches on it, so an ondelete hook fires with the expanded set and finds no descendants left to object to; the guard has to see the user's ORIGINAL selection, which only unlink() does. The raise carries a noqa saying so.

This gate is now a contract at zero rather than a floor of one.

  1 -> 0
